stem: Which statement best explains the appeal of LEGO products over the years?

options.label: F
options.text: People appreciate visiting theme parks where LEGO models are displayed.

options.label: G
options.text: People enjoy toys that allow them to be creative in many ways.

options.label: H
options.text: Toys made from plastic are lighter than those made from other materials.

options.label: J
options.text: LEGO is able to produce the plastic bricks quickly.
